title: Data sources and interpretation
text: SCAD repeats events span multiple locations. country-level use, contentiousR retains one row per positive event ID aggregating. documented -99, -88, -77 death-count values represented missing rather negative deaths. UCDP/PRIO expands conflicts multiple location codes aggregation. ucdp_prio_incidence marks active conflict country-year, ucdp_prio_onset one start_date2 falls year. VPP file equivalent episode-start field; ucdp_vpp_onset retained backwards-compatible alias ucdp_vpp_incidence. Mass Mobilization reports participant size mixture exact numbers, ranges, inequalities, qualitative strings. mm_participants contains maximum exact numeric reports. mm_participants_reported preserves reported strings users can apply substantively appropriate recoding. Legacy campaign episode sources can contain several rows one country-year. add_conflict(aggregate = TRUE) reports count takes missing-safe maximum numeric fields. Use aggregate = FALSE call conflict_data() directly campaign-level observations required. Unmatched panel rows remain NA, absence source always evidence zero events. MEC contains 2,734 reformist maximalist contentious episodes worldwide. contentiousR preserves episode-level rows published variables, using source’s byear year. Fourteen left-censored episodes mec_bdate 1955 source byear 1955. add_conflict(aggregate = TRUE), MEC follows explicit aggregation policy campaign episode sources; use aggregate = FALSE retain individual episodes. bundled UN WPP extract three rows China country-years: combined mainland+Hong Kong+Macao+Taiwan figure, mainland-figure, Hong Kong-figure, matched COW code 710 country-name conversion upstream. load_population_data(dataset = "wpp") resolves taking median pop value within cow-year group (returned wpp_pop), consistently mainland-figure; every country-year single row, median -op . NMC’s documented -9 missing-data sentinel recoded NA nmc_tpop nmc_upop. Fariss, Anders, Markowitz, Barnum’s replication files contain one row per country-year underlying source indicator (e.g. Bairoch, Penn World Table, World Bank) plus one "latent_*" row holding model’s combined estimate. load_gdp_data(dataset = "fariss") load_population_data(dataset = "fariss") keep "latent_gdp" / "latent_gdppc" / "latent_pop" rows. absolute units independently verified package; consult Fariss et al. (2022) using fariss_gdp, fariss_gdppc, fariss_pop outside relative/comparative analysis. SIPRI workbook lists small number rows (e.g. “Africa”, “NATO”) regional organizational aggregates rather countries; matching COW/Gleditsch-Ward code dropped. Barnum, Fariss, Markowitz, Morales’s military expenditure replication file contains one row per country-year 24 underlying source indicators, original currency/unit, single combined value real monetary scale (unlike Fariss GDP/population files, paper publish shared latent trait directly “average real direct monetary unit”). title: Add conflict spell (peace-years) durations to a state panel — add_spells
text: panel data frame produced build_states_panel(), optionally already joined conflict data via add_conflict(). event Character. Name binary (0/1) column compute spells . NULL (default), add_spells() looks exactly one column panel whose name ends _onset, _incidence, _ongoing; zero one match, errors asks explicit event. ongoing Logical. TRUE, event treated "ongoing" series run consecutive 1s one continuous event (first year run counts new failure; remaining years run get NA output, matching peacesciencer::add_spells()'s convention excluding within-event years spell measures time since last event). FALSE, every 1 event treated event, appropriate already onset-coded column. NULL (default), inferred column name: TRUE _incidence/_ongoing suffixes, FALSE _onset.

"_con_" indicators constant (inflation-adjusted) dollars, unlike nmc_milex dataset = "nmc", NMC documents current-year dollars. barnum_nmc therefore directly comparable nmc_milex: ratio varies smoothly time (e.g. around 2.4 United States 1990, falling toward 1 mid-2010s), reflects cumulative inflation adjustment rather disagreement two sources.
